title: BigP3BCI Study E — 6x6 checkerboard (8 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 8 healthy participants in Study E of the bigP3BCI collection. Participants used a P300-based speller with a 6x6 checkerboard character grid, and the recordings are labeled Target and NonTarget. Data were acquired with 16 EEG channels at 256 Hz using a g.USBamp amplifier. The dataset is a BIDS-formatted derivative of the PhysioNet bigP3BCI release, prepared with MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 16 channels placed according to the standard 10-20 montage, using a g.USBamp (g.tec) amplifier at a 256 Hz sampling rate. Each participant completed one session of a P300 speller task with a 6x6 checkerboard paradigm in a laboratory. Online feedback was given, and the protocol was calibration followed by test. Events were annotated as Target or NonTarget and tagged with HED.
